job: Explain what the product does as a few parts, ruled cells, editorial rows or one large part with smaller ones.
purpose: The product's capabilities. grid: two to four cells a row (data-cols on the items), each opened by a rule, with an icon in the text colour or an index numeral. list: editorial rows of index, title and text, read in order. bento: one framed object whose large cell holds a product specimen beside smaller cells; it collapses to one column on a phone.
useWhen: Three to six capabilities of equal weight (grid).
One capability that leads, with supporting ones (bento).

avoidWhen.when: One claim with one piece of media.
A checked list inside a plan or card.

variants.useWhen: An argument in order, with room for a sentence each.
One leading part with media, and smaller ones.

parts.role: The list; data-cols="2|3|4" on a grid.
An icon in the text colour.

relation.because: The feature list is a checked list of inclusions; this section lays out a product's capabilities on a public page.
